name: libmir-jit
description: Complete D bindings to MIR (vnmakarov/mir), a lightweight JIT compiler with a built-in optimizer

configurations.name: bundled
configurations.comment: Default: compile the vendored MIR C sources (c/mir) with cc and link the objects. No network, no system install.

configurations.name: system
configurations.comment: Link a system-installed MIR (libmir) instead of building the vendored sources.
